chunks: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'Suffice with forbearance as a helper.' And he (peace be upon him) said: 'When you are not forbearing, then become forbearing.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the virtue of forbearance and how to acquire it?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates forbearance (hilm) from a mere trait to a divine aid, asserting it is sufficient as a 'helper' against life's tribulations. He further provides a practical spiritual methodology for those lacking this innate quality, instructing them to actively cultivate it through conscious effort, reflecting the Shia emphasis on self-discipline (muraqabah) as a path to spiritual refinement.

en.hubeali: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Suffice with the forbearance as a helper’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you cannot become forbearing, so you should be tolerant’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from certain individuals of his people in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Forbearance is enough as a helper’ and he said, ‘If you are not a forbearing person at least pretend to be like a forebearing person.’”
